items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: I’d like for it maybe to be true because Miles, as you know Miles took my place with the Benny Carter band.

ctx.x: So you could buy your own Harmon mute, right?

Yeah. I could buy my own Harmon. Now the story is that is where the Miles Davis sound came from. It doesn’t have to be true. I’d like for it maybe to be true because Miles, as you know Miles took my place with the Benny Carter band.
